President.title: President
President.description: The President oversees the strategic direction of the party and is responsible for major decisions.

detailedDescription.heading: The President shall be the Chief Executive of the Association
points: Exercises overall control over the association’s affairs.
Presides over all key meetings and decision-making bodies.
Ensures administrative and legislative measures benefit members.
Operates bank accounts jointly with the General Secretary.
Manages urgent expenditures with later approval.

GeneralSecretary.title: General Secretary
GeneralSecretary.description: The General Secretary handles the internal functioning and administration of the party.

Treasurer.title: Treasurer
Treasurer.description: The Treasurer is responsible for the financial management of the party.

VicePresident.title: Vice President
VicePresident.description: The Vice President assists the President and steps in their absence.

JointSecretary.title: Joint Secretary
JointSecretary.description: The Joint Secretary assists the General Secretary in their duties and acts in their absence.
